observations: body L1-L12: the figure stands on the right of these lines and is redrawn from the print: the circle of the Moon about L (radius 19.3 pt), the lines TS and LS towards the Sun, parallel, the line TL through F, and the diameter CD, as strokes fitted to the print; below CD the dark half of the Moon is hatched with horizontal lines 1.56 pt apart, and the radius LB, perpendicular to TL, is left blank across the hatch lines; the radius LA prints with a gap, as drawn. The letters are bold italic. Since LC is perpendicular to LS and LA to LT, the angle CLA equals the angle of LS and LT, and with LS parallel to TS this is STL, as stated in L1.
body L2, L16, L22, L28, L36: «Al–Battānī» and «al–Battānī» are letter-spaced, with long dashes (5.3 to 5.4 pt); the dashes before them in L2 and L22 measure 9.7 and 10.4 pt.

body L4-L8: the mean motion of the Moon from the Sun in a day is 13° 10′ 35″ − 0° 59′ 8″ = 12° 11′ 27″, al-Battānī's 12° 11′ (p. 86, L22-L23); he found the arc of visibility near 12° (p. 86, L21). The h of «24ʰ» is a raised italic letter.

body L13-L17: 12° of the equator pass in 12 : 15 = 4/5 hour; in that time the Moon gains 12° 11′ × 0,8 : 24 = 24′ 22″ on the Sun, about 2/5 degree, and 12° 11′ − 24′ = 11° 47′, which al-Battānī rounds to 11° 3/4 = 11° 45′ (p. 86, L25-L29). A raised dot prints before «itaque» (L15).
body L19, L27: «ar-Raqqah» in L19 has a hyphen (3.6 pt), in L27 a long dash (4.4 pt).
body L20-L21: «per» at the end of L20 is printed without a hyphen; the word goes on as «pendicularis» in L21.
body L23: a raised dot prints before «occa-».
body L28: the t of «Longinquitas» prints broken.
body L28-L35: the third column is that of the table of correction in Part II, p. 89 (p. 87, L17-L21 of the translation: 30 minutes there mean the Moon at its mean distance); see the note.
body L36: the a of «qua» prints damaged.

notes L1-L2: «Ita al-Battānī p. 87» is the translation, p. 87, L18, where the column is the third because the two series of numbers of the argument are counted as two columns (note 2 there); otherwise it is the second column. «al-Battānī» has a hyphen (3.7 pt).
